## Termination Clause (TC)

Extends the shared Clause additively with exit mechanics: notice period, for-convenience right, cure period for breach, early-exit fee. Instances set `clauseType` to `termination`.

### Non-goals

No termination workflow — ending a contract is a status transition on Contract; this card is the library language.
